appeared. Litany: Let us ask; [Prayer]: Save [us].
Prayer: King of peace.

Monday. Tone 7 [dzy]. Of the Holy Witnesses: Antoninus, Theophilus, Anictu, and Photinus. Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 3 [by]: O Unvengeful One.
Midday:
Psalm 115 [116]: Precious is.
Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 3:1 to verse 8: forever.
Prophet Isaiah 48:16: Thus says the Lord, to verse 17: by which you should go.
Epistle 2 Timothy 3:10: But you followed, to verse 16: in Christ Jesus.
Alleluia: The righteous.
Gospel John 15:11: These things I have spoken, to verse 16: He may give you.

Tuesday. Tone 8 [gky]. Feast of the Holy Prophet Daniel and the Three Youth: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Canticle [ah.] Tone 2 [ak]: Who the divine. Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 2 [ak]: Who art exalted. Mercy and Heaven's [Oghormya and Ter yerknyts] for the Prophets say. [Mankunk] and [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [dz]: Who beforehand.
Midday Introit: Who upon the cherubim. Patristic Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 1 [adz]: Ray [of light].
Psalm 67 [68]: In the churches. Change [Antiphon]: Let Him arise.
Prophet Daniel 2:1: In the second year, to verse 19: at the king's gate.
Epistle Hebrews 11:32: And now what more, to verse 40: they should be made perfect.
Alleluia: In the churches.
Gospel Matthew 24:9: Then they will deliver, to verse 15: let him understand.

Wednesday. Tone 1 [ad]. Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 1 [ad]: Sang the youths.
Midday:
Psalm 85 [86]: Save your servant.
Epistle Romans 9:1: With truth, to verse 16: who shows mercy.
Alleluia: Your Holy Spirit.
Gospel Matthew 13:1: On that day, to verse 8: thirty-fold.

Thursday. Tone 2 [ah]. Of the Holy Translators: Isaac [Sahak] and Mesrop. Canticle [ah.] Tone 2 [ak]: Who adorned, with its proper parts [canon]. [Mankunk] and [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [gy]: Likened to Moses.
Midday:
Psalm 14 [15]: The God-fearing.
Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 8:7: If righteousness, to verse 10: from the elders.
Prophet Isaiah 61:6: But you priests, to verse 9: shall be in the Lord.
Epistle 1 Corinthians 12:4: Although there are, to verse 11: as He wills.
Alleluia: Your priests.
Gospel Luke 12:32: Do not fear, to verse 40: the Son of Man.

Friday. Tone 3 [bd]. Patristic Hymn [Harts] of Rest Tone 7 [dzy]: We bless You.
Midday:
Psalm 97 [98]: All the ends have seen.
Epistle Romans 9:17: For the Scripture says, to verse 27: shall remain.
Alleluia: My heart was troubled.
Gospel Matthew 13:16: But blessed are your, to verse 23: some thirty-fold.

Saturday. Tone 4 [bky]. Of the Holy King Tiridates [Trdat] of ours, and Queen Ashkhen, and Khosrovidukht. Canticle [ah.] Tone 2 [ak]: Who the heavenly, with its proper parts. [Mankunk] Tone 7 [dz]: Who supreme.
Midday Introit: As after the God-loving. Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 3 [by]: God Savior.
Psalm 20 [21]: Lord in power.
Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 6:2: Hear, O kings, to verse 10: do not stumble.
Prophet Isaiah 45:1: Thus says the Lord, to verse 3: of Israel.
Epistle 1 Timothy 2:1: And now I exhort, to verse 7: in truth.
Alleluia: Let them rejoice.
Gospel Luke 11:14: And he cast out, to verse 23: scatters.
In the Evening:
"Joyful Light" [Phos Hilaron], etc., according to the order.
Then the Pre-feast [Nakhatonak] of the Holy Mother of God.
Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 2 [ak]: Who foreknew, with its proper parts.

Fifth Sunday after Pentecost. Tone 5 [ez]. Feast of the Discovery of the Casket [T'p'oy] of the Holy Mother of God. Canticle [ah.] Tone 6 [gky]: Sing, O children, with its proper parts. Alleluia of the Nativity.
Morning Song: He shall come down like rain. Litany: Holy Mother. Psalm 109 [110]: In the beauty, aloud. Antiphon: The Lord said to my Lord.
Gospel Luke 1:26: And in the month, to verse 38: the angel departed from her.
Then: "Newly-created" [Norasteghdzyal]. Litany: Let us ask; [Prayer]: Save [us]. Prayer: Your all-powerful.
Midday: Everything is of the Resurrection.
Psalm 64 [65]: Praise is due to You.
Prophet Isaiah 2:5: And now you, to verse 11: on that day.
Psalm 47 [48]: Great is the Lord.
Epistle Romans 9:30: What shall we say then, to chapter 10:4: of those who believe.
Alleluia: Let them rejoice.
Gospel Matthew 13:24: Another parable he put forth, to verse 30: into my barn.
In the Evening:
Messiah [Mese] of the Nativity. Litany: Holy Mother.
Hambartsi [Hmb.] Tone 7 [dz]: New Sion. Litany: The Holy Mother of God, [Prayer]: Save [us]. Prayer: Receive, Lord.
